subject.title: feat: bound reads from open file descriptors

question: Should fs-safe permanently expose these three advanced descriptor-read helpers and treat only `EPERM` from pinned-write `fsync` as best-effort success?
rationale: Both choices expand or alter externally observable library behavior beyond the mechanical overflow-classification repair, so implementation review cannot establish the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Approve the API and EPERM policy
options.body: Keep the new advanced helpers and narrowly documented EPERM compatibility behavior, after the structured-read error classification is repaired.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Retain the internal capped-read race fix but defer public helper exports, JSON options, or EPERM success semantics until their contracts are separately approved.

options.title: Pause for API discussion
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide the desired descriptor-read and durability guarantees for fs-safe consumers.

recommendation.title: Approve the API and EPERM policy
recommendation.body: Keep the new advanced helpers and narrowly documented EPERM compatibility behavior, after the structured-read error classification is repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed surface and compatibility semantics are introduced by this PR's two commits.
